examples.title: Example 1: Displaying a Basic Menu
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to display a basic menu by configuring MenuElement for bindMenu.

examples.title: Example 2: Displaying a Custom Menu
examples.description: This example shows how to use bindMenu with a custom builder to create a custom menu. In addition, starting from API version 18, the hapticFeedbackMode property in ContextMenuOptions can be configured to implement the haptic feedback effect when the menu is displayed.

examples.title: Example 3: Displaying a Menu on Long Press
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to display a menu by setting responseType.LongPress for bindContextMenu.

examples.title: Example 4: Displaying a Menu with an Arrow on Right-Clicking
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to display a menu with an arrow by setting the enableArrow property in responseType.RightClick and ContextMenuOptions for bindContextMenu. In addition, starting from API version 18, the hapticFeedbackMode property in ContextMenuOptions can be configured to implement the haptic feedback effect when the menu is displayed.

examples.title: Example 5: Displaying a Menu with a Screenshot Preview on Long Press
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to display a menu with a screenshot preview by setting MenuPreviewMode of the preview property in responseType.LongPress and ContextMenuOptions for bindContextMenu.

examples.title: Example 6: Displaying a Menu with a Custom Preview on Long Press
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to display a menu with a custom preview by setting CustomBuilder of the preview property in responseType.LongPress and ContextMenuOptions for bindContextMenu.

examples.title: Example 7: Using a State Variable for Menu Visibility
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use bindContextMenu with isShown to control the visibility of the menu.

examples.title: Example 8: Using Custom Menu and Preview Animations
examples.description: This example demonstrates how implement custom entrance and exit animations for the menu and preview by setting the transition property in ContextMenuOptions of bindContextMenu.

examples.title: Example 9: Setting the Symbol Icon
examples.description: This example shows how to display a menu with symbol icons by setting symbolIcon in MenuElement of bindMenu.

examples.title: Example 10: Using Shared Element Transition
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement a shared element transition effect from the component screenshot to the custom preview by setting hoverScale of the previewAnimationOptions property in ContextMenuOptions for bindContextMenu.

examples.title: Example 11: Customizing the Background Blur Effect
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to customize the blur background effect of a menu by setting the backgroundBlurStyleOptions property in ContextMenuOptions for bindMenu.
The backgroundBlurStyleOptions property is added to ContextMenuOptions since API version 18.

examples.title: Example 12: Customizing the Background Effect
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to customize the background effect of a menu by setting the backgroundEffect property in ContextMenuOptions for bindMenu.
The backgroundEffect property is added to ContextMenuOptions since API version 18.

examples.title: Sample 13: Configuring Lift-Finger Interruption for a Shared Element Transition
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to implement a shared element transition by setting the previewAnimationOptions property in ContextMenuOptions for bindContextMenu and how to control whether lifting the finger after a long press can cancel the menu pop-up by setting hoverScaleInterruption.
From API version 20, the hoverScaleInterruption property is added to the ContextMenuAnimationOptions type of previewAnimationOptions.

examples.title: Sample 14: Setting the Radius of the Rounded Corners of the Preview Image Border
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to implement the function using bindContextMenu with responseType.LongPress set. In addition, the MenuPreviewMode type of the preview property in ContextMenuOptions is set to determine the menu preview mode. previewBorderRadius is set to implement the radius of the rounded corners of the preview image.
In API version 19, the previewBorderRadius property is added to ContextMenuOptions.

examples.title: Sample 15: Configuring Lifecycle Callbacks for bindMenu
examples.description:
This example shows how to configure the lifecycle callback for bindMenu.
From API version 20, the onWillAppear, onDidAppear, onWillDisappear, and onDidDisappear properties are added to ContextMenuOptions.

examples.title: Example 16: Setting the Menu Mask
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to implement the menu mask using bindMenu with the mask property.
In API version 20, the mask property is added to ContextMenuOptions.

examples.title: Example 17: Setting the Outline Style of a Drop-Down Menu Using bindMenu
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to set the outline style of the drop-down menu by setting the outlineWidth and outlineColor properties of bindMenu.
In API version 20, the outlineWidth and outlineColor properties are added to ContextMenuOptions.

examples.title: Example 18: Passing a CustomBuilder with Parameters to bindMenu
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to configure the properties of a menu by passing a CustomBuilder with parameters to bindMenu.

examples.title: Sample 19: Displaying Different Menus Based on the Trigger Mode
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to bind a menu to the target component by passing CustomBuilderT<ResponseType> to bindContextMenuWithResponse. The component returns the mode of triggering menu display in the UI function. You can implement differentiated display based on the returned trigger mode.
The bindContextMenuWithResponse API is added since API version 23.

examples.title: Example 20: Setting the Menu to Avoid the Soft Keyboard
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to configure the menu to avoid the soft keyboard by setting keyboardAvoidMode in bindMenu and set the minimum distance for avoiding the soft keyboard by setting minKeyboardAvoidDistance.
Starting from API version 23, the** keyboardAvoidMode** and minKeyboardAvoidDistance properties are added to ContextMenuOptions.

examples.title: Example 21: Setting the Position of the Menu to Display Relative to the Upper Left Corner of the Bound Component
examples.description:
This example shows how to set the anchorPosition property in ContextMenuOptions to display the menu relative to the upper left corner of the bound component.
The anchorPosition property is added to ContextMenuOptions since API version 20.
